capabilities: : Adjust width using a live slider
: Display current width in status bar
intentEvidence: Obsidian only gives you two choices for how wide your notes are: narrow (with big empty margins on both sides) or full width.
problem: Obsidian limits note width to only two fixed options (narrow or full width), which may not suit specific reading or writing preferences.
summary: Note Width Changer allows users to set custom text widths in pixels or percent using a live slider, overriding Obsidian's default narrow or full-width options.
